items.event_time_ist: Oct 20, 2026 (Tuesday; during a visit to Army drone production facilities, reported Oct 21)
items.summary: Maj. Gen. Ali Abdollahi, Chief of Staff of Iran's Armed Forces, warned during an Oct 20 visit to drone production facilities that any renewed aggression against Iran would be met with a 'much stronger and more forceful response'; he hailed the expansion of the Army's drone manufacturing lines and said Iran would offset expensive US equipment with affordable systems, making any enemy operations 'more costly and difficult'.
items.title: Iran's armed forces chief warns renewed attack will draw a 'much stronger and more forceful response'

items.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio, in an Oct 20 Network18 interview in Mumbai, called making a deal with Iran 'tough' and accused Tehran of 'Nazi U-boat tactics' by targeting commercial shipping; he said Hormuz traffic and energy flows are at 80-100% of pre-war levels, that US forces intercept most Iranian drones and missiles fired at ships (some still getting through), and that Indian sailors were among those affected — pledging continued US efforts to protect shipping.
items.title: Rubio accuses Iran of 'Nazi U-boat tactics' against commercial shipping
